mapping.spatial_modifications: None: no horizontal shift, rotation, crop, resampling or flip was applied.

verification.publisher_evidence: Source page explicitly describes the maps as real planetary maps in equirectangular projection.
verification.visual_evidence: Decoded and viewed every delivered JPEG. Day/night coastlines, specular land mask, and normal relief share the Greenwich-centered layout: Americas left, Europe/Africa at center, Asia/Australia right, Antarctica at bottom. UK/West Africa positions are consistent with Greenwich at the horizontal midpoint. Cloud image retains the matching source orientation; visible Greenland and Antarctic features are consistent with the other maps.
verification.accuracy_limit: Orientation and landmark alignment verified visually, not by survey-grade control points. Files contain no independently verified geographic transform. Cloud alignment has less certainty than the coastline maps because it depicts weather rather than a land mask.

mapping.threejs_note: Use consistent UVs and texture orientation for all maps. For ordinary TextureLoader images, default flipY=true corresponds to north at UV v=1. A custom globe coordinate convention may still require a mesh rotation; do not shift one map independently.

transparency.clouds: clouds.jpg is an opaque RGB JPEG with grayscale cloud intensity, not a transparent PNG. Use its intensity as an alpha/opacity mask on a white cloud layer: black=transparent, white=opaque, gray=partial. In Three.js, alphaMap reads the green channel; enable transparency. No alpha-channel asset was created.
transparency.cloud_limitations: Original map includes bright polar/Greenland features. It is an artistic static cloud mask, not a scientifically isolated current cloud field.

rendering_data_notes.day_and_night: Color textures: typically sRGB. Night has a dim colored Earth background as well as lights, not an isolated binary light mask.
rendering_data_notes.clouds_specular_normal: Treat opacity, specular and normal values as non-color data (Three.js NoColorSpace).
rendering_data_notes.specular: White water/ocean and black land; some inland water is white. This is a water/specularity mask, not a roughness map. Roughness generally needs inverse interpretation.
rendering_data_notes.normal: RGB tangent-space-looking normal map with blue/purple neutral areas; not a grayscale bump map. Publisher does not document normal Y-channel handedness; verify raised terrain in the renderer before choosing normalScale.y sign. No normal-channel inversion was applied. JPEG conversion is lossy; retained TIFF is the unmodified master.
